statements.impact_statement: govulncheck v1.6.0 binary-mode analysis found no affected gRPC symbols in the Prometheus v3.13.1 binary; the service exposes Prometheus HTTP only and configures neither a gRPC server nor xDS RBAC.
statements.action_statement: Keep the service bound to host loopback, retain CPU and memory limits, and remove this statement when an upstream release built with google.golang.org/grpc v1.82.1 or newer is pinned.
